Ukraine sinks Russian warship in Libya, Zelenskyy hails operation

Ukraine conducted a long-range assault, sinking the Russian Navy corvette Merkury at a naval base in Libya. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy hailed the operation as "exemplary." The attack occurred approximately 2,400 kilometers (1,500 miles) from the front lines in Ukraine. Russia has reacted with anger to Ukraine's ongoing campaign targeting its shipping, warning of a "dangerous trend."
